title: New STEM Detection in TEM: Pneumatic Retractable Arm and Multi-Channel Amplification System
content: We present a fully integrated multi-channel Transmission Electron Detector (STEM-Detector) for Transmission Electron Microscopes (TEM), comprising the complete detection chain: from the detector and advanced STEM Module to the newly developed Pneumatic Retractable Arm, full amplification, and acquisition system. This system supports up to 13 individual amplified channels, providing unparalleled flexibility and performance in STEM detection. Each channel is amplified and digitized separately, allowing for digital combination of signals as needed, with minimum pixel dwell times below 20 ns and no limitations on parallel acquisition and mixing of individual signals.
